jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager, Events
jobs_results.description: Department: Events and MWC Barcelona Location: Barcelona Position type: Full-time Permanent Reporting to: MWC Barcelona Event Director About the GSMA The GSMA, www.gsma.com, is a global mobile operator-led organisation unifying the mobile ecosystem to discover, develop and deliver innovation foundational to positive business environments and societal change. Our vision is to unlock the full power of connectivity so that people, industry, and society thrive. Representing mobile operators and organisations across the mobile ecosystem and adjacent industries worldwide, the GSMA delivers for its members across three broad pillars: Industry Services and Solutions: We provide strategic direction, thought leadership to our members and we drive collaborative industry programmes aimed at maintaining operator relevance in the digital world. Connectivity for Good: We advocate for the industry to regulators, policy makers and society as a whole. Outreach: We convene the broad mobile... communications ecosystem at our industry leading events such as MWC Barcelona, MWC Shanghai, MWC Las Vegas, MWC Africa and the Mobile 360 Series conferences. About the Team The MWC Barcelona PMO is a dedicated team within the GSMA who work across, and in close collaboration with our internal / external stakeholders and strategic partners to deliver the largest, most influential event for the global connectivity ecosystem. What the hiring manager says We have an exciting opening for a highly motivated Sr. Project Manager to join our dynamic events team in Barcelona. This role is a unique opportunity for the right candidate to support and contribute to the success of key strategic projects and initiatives of MWC Barcelona – the GSMAs flagship mobile industry and technology event. We are seeking an ideal candidate with a growth mindset, who is a constant learner, embodies the spirit of collaboration, and excels in coordination, planning, efficient project management, attention to detail, and strong focus on impact rather than outcome. Your ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment will be instrumental in this role, and your excellent communication skills, team-player attitude and talent for building strong relationships will undeniably drive your success within our team. If you are ready to take on this challenge and make a significant impact on a global stage, we look forward to receiving your application. Join us in Barcelona and be part of an exceptional team dedicated to shaping the future of connectivity! About the Role Senior Project Manager - Mobile World Congress Barcelona: Take ownership of various programs and initiatives, driving them forward with determination and delivering impactful results. We're seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager who thrives in autonomous roles, excels in global environments, and remains composed under pressure. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with the MWC Barcelona Event Director, PMO, and GSMA cross-functional teams to effectively manage and deliver against priorities. We're looking for a dedicated team player who possesses exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail. Your ability to actively engage and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders will be crucial in achieving our project objectives. These responsibilities include, but are not limited to the below: Program / Initiatives Project Management: Lead and drive the execution of multiple projects and programs, overseeing every aspect from initiation to closure. This includes meticulous reporting, rigorous quality assurance, comprehensive data analysis, and proactive management of risks and budgets throughout the project lifecycle. Continuously seek insights and opportunities for improvement to enhance project outcomes and stakeholder satisfaction. Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary point of contact for a diverse range of stakeholders, including internal teams, external partners, and governmental entities. Manage and balance their expectations effectively to ensure alignment with project objectives and timelines. Provide direct support to the MWC Barcelona Event Director in liaising with all internal stakeholders and MWC Barcelona Virtual Team Coordination management (team communication, coordination & alignment, roles and responsibilities and key documentation) Communication and Negotiation: Utilise strong communication skills to establish and maintain productive relationships with key stakeholders, partners, and suppliers. Proactively manage dependencies and resolve conflicts through constructive dialogue and negotiation, fostering an environment of collaboration and mutual understanding. Demonstrate adept problem-solving skills to address challenges as they arise, ensuring timely resolution and alignment with project goals. Supplier and partner management: Cultivate and nurture relationships with suppliers and partners, serving as the main point of contact for day-to-day interactions. Maintain open lines of communication, establish clear expectations, and coordinate closely with GSMA teams to ensure seamless integration of external requirements. Monitor progress diligently, identifying any issues or delays and taking proactive steps to mitigate risks and drive performance excellence. Other Barcelona-specific activities: Opportunities to engage in additional local initiatives and cross-functional projects as needed, leveraging your expertise to support the broader organisational objectives within the Barcelona region. About You Team Collaboration and Proactivity: As a strong team player, demonstrate a proactive "can-do" attitude. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a global physical and virtual team environment. Project Management Experience: Extensive experience in project management within the events industry and under an international framework. Prioritisation and Ownership: Ability to prioritise effectively while managing multiple responsibilities, tasks, and relationships simultaneously. Demonstrates ownership and utilises available resources efficiently. Problem-Solving and Critical Thinking: Exhibit critical thinking, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Dedication and Meeting Expectations: Demonstrate unwavering dedication and willingness to go the extra mile to meet expectations, even under tight deadlines. Negotiation Skills and Financial Management: Exceptional negotiation skills and experience in budget and P/L management. Autonomous Work and Service Focus: Previous experience working autonomously in a service-focused organisation, demonstrating ownership and resourceful utilisation of available support. Professionalism and Confidentiality: Maintain a high level of confidentiality and professionalism in all interactions. Relationship Building and Customer Focus: Excel at building relationships and fostering connections throughout the organisation. Maintain composure and friendliness under pressure while being mindful of cultural diversity. Communication Skills: Excellent communication both English & Spanish written/oral. Intermediate written and spoken Catalan is required and an advanced level will be a bonus. Presentation and Data Analysis Skills: Proficient in writing and building presentations with attention to detail. Ability to synthesise vast amounts of information into actionable recommendations and compelling narratives. Strong foundation in data analysis and data visualisation. Technical Skills: Excellent skills in using MS Office tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Word) and other office/online applications. Contract type Regular Worker type Employee What We Offer Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish. In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others. To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page. Being You at the GSMA We are one of the most diverse companies you will ever come across, we care deeply about equality and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important so if you prefer to work flexi-time or a day from home, just ask. We’re keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The success of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life. GSMA Values Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation. Passionately driven We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact. Insightful leaders We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance. Stronger together We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help. Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play. If you're currently an employee at GSMA, please apply internally using the GSMAHub by clicking on ‘Jobs Hub’ in your main Dashboard. About the GSMA The GSMA is a global organisation unifying the mobile ecosystem to discover, develop and deliver innovation foundational to positive business environments and societal change. Our vision is to unlock the full power of connectivity so that people, industry, and society thrive. Representing mobile operators and organisations across the mobile ecosystem and adjacent industries, the GSMA delivers for its members across three broad pillars: Industry Services and Solutions, Connectivity for Good, and Outreach. Connectivity for Good engages members, governments and civil society, to advance positive policy and spectrum outcomes, facilitate digital innovation to reduce inequalities in our world, and tackle todays’ biggest societal challenges such as digital inclusion, climate change and sustainability. Industry Services and Solutions underpins the technology and interoperability that make mobile work. Via our projects, working groups and promotional activities we facilitate the industry’s focus on areas such as 5G, Mobile IoT, fraud and security. And our technical services offer tools, data and resources to enable even more efficient and robust mobile experiences for users. Outreach provides the world’s largest platform, convening and informing the mobile ecosystem, at MWC Barcelona, Shanghai, Los Angeles and the M360 series, and through Mobile World Live and GSMA Intelligence with breaking news, insights and expert analysis. We invite you to find out more at gsma.com

jobs_results.title: Finance and Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

Job Description

OVERALL OBJECTIVES

As a Finance and Project Manager, you will take on a leadership role in the Eurofins finance organisation in Spain. The role includes leading Finance Projects (such as integrating... acquired companies), Purchasing, Finance IT, and Payroll, ensuring current and new projects are successfully launched and executed exceptionally well.

POSITION

Leadership and management of three departments, including purchasing, payroll and finance IT, contributing to the successful implementation of new projects:
• Purchasing/procurement
• Develop and implement sourcing strategies in close collaboration with the Group Purchasing and local team.
• Ensure Group-wide reporting on purchasing and the exact calculation of savings obtained.
• Improve cost savings and price – volume – mix analysis and implement data analytics tools and reports to support business leaders’ strategic decisions.
• Launch new projects mainly focused on indirect costs to achieve savings and synergies across the business lines.
• Payroll and HR administration
• Support payroll and HR administration and the implementation of a payroll system, along with the Payroll Manager.
• Set up payroll processes from scratch, describing tasks, controls, and designing the task distribution and organization between the business lines and the service centre.
• Finance IT
• Define and manage all relevant IT projects in the area of Finance and Purchasing.
• Define, implement and ensure the application of optimised and harmonised processes in line with the Group standard in the area of Finance and Purchasing.
• Support the integration of new entities and improve the integration process from an IT perspective.
• Lunch new IT-related projects with a strong focus on optimisation and automation.
• Driving the implementation of standard processes and systems
• Active contribution to and validation of the design of standard Group-wide Finance & Purchasing processes.
• Drive the implementation of these standard processes, KPIs and controls across the different businesses and functions.
• Driving the integration of newly acquired entities, improving the process and reducing integration time

Qualifications

We are looking for someone with strong leadership skills who is not afraid to stimulate open communication. Driven by the passion to succeed, you should not be afraid to challenge the “status quo”.

In addition, as a finance professional, you should be a very structured, accurate, highly reliable, strong leader, as well as a hands-on team player. We are looking for someone with the ability to dive into the right level of details when needed, as well as to create and follow a vision.

Ideally, you should be educated up to Master’s level in finance, accounting or equivalent, with a minimum of eight years’ work experience in finance leading multiple teams, including finance, IT, purchasing and payroll. You should also be able to communicate effectively in both English and Spanish.

Execution driven, accountability for hitting proposed targets, and people-oriented, creating a positive work environment and delivering honest and upfront engaging messages to the teams.

Join one of the fastest growing listed European companies, where successful leaders are frequently being offered increased areas of responsibility (subject to geographic mobility). Apply now!

Additional Information

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.7 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years

jobs_results.title: Workpackage manager (m/f)
jobs_results.description:
Location: Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Ensures... work package management for the system engineering perimeter from inputs (costs, schedule, quality, development plan) provided by the PM and SEM/EDM.

Participates to the system engineering activities, in the system engineering core team, under the PDA & SEM/EDM
• Contributes to Analyse the system requirements
• Contributes to Describe the missions, functions and requirements on the solution or the product
• Contributes to Formalise the specification and the architectural design to develop the solution or product
• Contributes to justify the solution design versus the system requirements
• contributes to the identification and management of the risks
• Contributes to the realization of system trade-offs

In the frame of a large , complex space programme with a high level of innovation

We are looking a candidate with:
• Degree in Engineering
• Experience in optical / quantum space systems
• Very good understanding of development cycles

Skills to make the difference:
• Responsible
• Rigorous
• Results oriented
• Pragmatic
• Good team and communication skills
• Willing to face new challenges
• Comfortable to make decisions

What do we offer?
• Smart Working (teleworking, flexible working time, equipment & tools endowment, etc.).
• Free meals at the office.
• 28 business days of vacation.
• Pension plan.
• Individual training programs.
• Good working environment.

If you like teamwork, are looking for a new opportunity where you can learn new technologies for space-business and you are dynamic and results oriented, we're looking for you!

We will consider being in possession of a certificate of disability.

At Thales Alenia Space we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales Alenia Space employing around 8,900 employees in 10 countries with 17 sites in Europe and a plant in the US, our mobility policy enables employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad. Thales Alenia Space sees space as a new horizon, helping to build a better, more sustainable life on Earth #SpaceForLife. Great journeys start here, apply now

Location: Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain

A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate.

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America.

Ensures... work package management for the system engineering perimeter from inputs (costs, schedule, quality, development plan) provided by the PM and SEM/EDM.

Participates to the system engineering activities, in the system engineering core team, under the PDA & SEM/EDM
• Contributes to Analyse the system requirements
• Contributes to Describe the missions, functions and requirements on the solution or the product
• Contributes to Formalise the specification and the architectural design to develop the solution or product
• Contributes to justify the solution design versus the system requirements
• contributes to the identification and management of the risks
• Contributes to the realization of system trade-offs

In the frame of a large , complex space programme with a high level of innovation

We are looking a candidate with:
• Degree in Engineering
• Experience in optical / quantum space systems
• Very good understanding of development cycles

Skills to make the difference:
• Responsible
• Rigorous
• Results oriented
• Pragmatic
• Good team and communication skills
• Willing to face new challenges
• Comfortable to make decisions

What do we offer?
• Smart Working (teleworking, flexible working time, equipment & tools endowment, etc.).
• Free meals at the office.
• 28 business days of vacation.
• Pension plan.
• Individual training programs.
• Good working environment.

If you like teamwork, are looking for a new opportunity where you can learn new technologies for space-business and you are dynamic and results oriented, we're looking for you!

We will consider being in possession of a certificate of disability.

At Thales Alenia Space we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales Alenia Space employing around 8,900 employees in 10 countries with 17 sites in Europe and a plant in the US, our mobility policy enables employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad. Thales Alenia Space sees space as a new horizon, helping to build a better, more sustainable life on Earth #SpaceForLife. Great journeys start here, apply now

jobs_results.title: Clinical Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Purpose

Coordinate projects from development to product launch, coordinating the needs of all the involved departments (R&D, toxicology clinic records, production, quality, clinical operations, business development and sales) to streamline the development process, ensure that the times and budgets are under control and achieve a successful registration and launch of the product on the market.

Responsibilities
• Ensure the correct understanding of the needs of the development plan from strategy to detailed tasks by all the people involved.
• Analyze the needs of each project and design stages and milestones in calendar (scope, goals, schedule, timelines, quality, resources, etc.).
• Propose alternative or contingency solutions to changes or problems in implementation.
• Propose allocation of responsibilities and resources.
• Ensure optimization of resources (capital, effort, organization, departments, systems, etc.), time, cost and quality.
• Establish communication and control... system (system of recording and reporting on project progress, deviations, shares, etc.).
• Track each phase in order to ensure the implementation of all actions to improve and ensure a high level of quality and compliance with the set standards.

Requirements
• Education: University Degree, preferred Pharmacy or similar. PhD in Pharmaceutical area. PMP training will be very valuable.
• Advanced English, knowledge of other languages will be an asset.
• 2/3 years of experience in project management in the pharmaceutical industry.

Skills
• Proactivity, leadership, communication skills, multitasking and global mindset to work with local and international teams, initiative to improve processes

jobs_results.title: Digital Project Manager (Shopify Development) with ITALIAN
jobs_results.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Rocket Digital we help companies grow, transform and enhance their digital strategy by creating brands, experiences and products that generate value in their customers. We work with personalized teams for each project, formed by the best specialized talents.

We carry out consultancy, data management, selection of channels, measurement of performance and attribution model. We offer experience and cross-channel technology. We work with full-funnel models, creating 360 degree strategies.

We focus on hiring the best people and empowering everyone to be better. Here you will find a young and ambitious team ready to change the way in which technology can help deliver better digital advertising across the world.

We are seeking a Digital Project Manager and Scrum Master with a passion for building products based on data for our customers. The ideal candidate will have some knowledge in each stage of product development process:
• UX Research & Design
• Software development... (CMS or custom made)
• Web analytics
• CRO

You don’t need detailed knowledge in any area (we have specialists in each area), but enough knowledge to lead other people from these areas. You will work with cross-functional team members and will rely heavily on both qualitative and quantitative data to make informed decisions.

Responsibilities

By partnering with cross-functional teams and customers, you will turn your insights into delightful products in a creative environment that requires proven leadership skills and the ability to execute a creative vision.

As a Project Manager at Rocket Digital, you will take part in:
• Analyze customer needs and write a scope for the project.
• Identify new product improvement opportunities.
• Analyze how a product satisfies market needs and consumer preferences.
• Stay up to date on current industry trends and market conditions.
• Lead teams in order to build new products.
• Keep customers informed of product development status.
• Modify and revise existing designs to meet changing customer preferences.
• Work closely with product engineers to suggest improvements for products and processes.
• Testing new products

jobs_results.title: (Senior) Project Manager in Consulting for Strategic Procurement ...
jobs_results.description:
Introduction

We are one of the top names for strategic procurement and supply chain management. As an independent subsidiary of BCG, we offer the best of both worlds: in-depth expertise and high strategic competence and we are able to draw on a strong, international infrastructure, which makes us even more dynamic in the market.

That’s why we want to strengthen our team. With someone that matches our ambitions as well as our spirit. So that we remain not only very successful, but also very INVERTO.

Join our 2023 newly opened office in Madrid from September onwards and be part of another successful growth story!

VERY EXCITING FOR YOU.

Holistic project management.

You will be responsible for the development and successful implementation of suitable strategies to optimize the supply chain and strategic procurement process. You will demonstrate your entrepreneurial talent in project controlling and in the acquisition of new customers.

Broad range of challenges.

Broad customer... portfolios and project assignments at home and abroad for a wide variety of industries and customers. From start-ups, retail, and consumer goods, to the energy and automotive industries or the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors.

Intensive customer consulting.

You will work closely with customers, be their main contact person and be responsible for conducting your team's workshops, negotiations and presentations.

Specific development.

Your professional expertise will help to drive forward the development of knowledge in our company.

Far-reaching responsibility.

You will ensure that your team develops both professionally and personally. As a member of the INVERTO management team, you can help shape the development of our entire company and give it the necessary impetus.

VERY IMPORTANT FOR US.

University degree with above-average grades and 4-8 years of relevant professional experience.

Extensive expertise in consulting, ideally in procurement / supply chain management and a passion for strategic and operational work.

You have already proven your analytical and conceptual skills at management level in demanding projects. You show full commitment, are customer-oriented and cooperative. You have shown that you can successfully lead teams professionally and personally.

Very INVERTO: Team player. Both feet firmly on the ground. Fair. Fun.

Confident appearance in an international environment, business fluent in English and Spanish, flexible in your professional mobility.

VERY BENEFIT.

Regular team evenings, a multi-day annual conference, employee and sport events.

Professional career development.

Support of your academic further training.

If needed: a longer timeout.

Comprehensive insurance package.

A company car that you can also use privately.

Employee referral programs.

Child- & eldercare, coaching.

Interested?

Please apply online via the INVERTO applicant portal. Ms Simone Mavero is available to answer your questions by calling +39 0289 743 045 or sending an e-mail to karriere@inverto.com

INVERTO GmbH

jobs_results.description: IRC225214 – BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER SPAIN At Eni, we are looking for a Business Development/ Senior Project Manager Spain within Plenitude in Madrid, Spain. You will be responsible for Supervising, managing, and planning the feasibility assessments of greenfield projects (PV, wind and storage) and leading the administrative permitting processes to enable the development of the projects. About Plenitude Plenitude is an energy company that integrates the retail business and renewable generation with self-consumption and electric mobility solutions, providing energy and gas to more than 10 million homes and businesses across Europe, which offers a range of great professional opportunities for the whole team. This membership represents a major European project, integrating the renewables business with the retail business and will allow us to progressively increase our offer of services, infrastructures and green energy for our customers, providing our team with... greater professional projection and growth. Plenitude is currently seeking to grow its Strategy & Pricing team in Cantabria, by hiring a Data Analyst. As a member of the Development Project Manager & Services Team at Plenitude, you will be responsible for: · Managing the necessary studies and required evaluation to obtain satisfactory environmental evaluations; · Interacting with grid operators (REE and distribution companies) and leading the requests to obtain new grid access; · Coordinating and management of stakeholders and third parties of the assigned projects, up to the start of the construction phase of the projects; · Monitoring and tracking progress of the development and permitting phase, to ensure that all projects are delivered on time and with the expected quality levels, within scope and budget; · Contributing to preparation of bids in auction processes (subastas de energía, concursos de capacidad) · Coordinating of reports and control required according to in-house corporate standards for the flawless development and permitting processes; · Promoting a healthy and safe working environment. This is the opportunity for you if you have these skills and requirements: · Master’s/Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Environmental or similar · Previous experience in similar positions in the renewable sector (solar/ wind). Previous experience as an Owner’s Engineer or Technical Advisor having participated in DD processes is a plus. · Use of computer software tools (Sigpac, Office, …). Knowledge of Autocad would be a plus. · Good knowledge of English and French is required · Driving license to facilitate visits to the project sites and local authorities. · Effective communication, problem-solving, critical thinking and leadership Location: Madrid, Spain Contract type: Permanent At Eni we believe in enterprising people, capable of making a difference and making their contribution with passion and innovation, to respond to the global challenges of the energy transition. For us, the skills and attitudes of each individual, continuous training, and diversity and inclusion are fundamental. We promote flexible ways of working with particular attention to well-being, welfare and work life-balance. Eni will evaluate applications considering plurality and diversity as sources of enrichment. If your application is assessed to be among those most in line with the required profile, you will be contacted to continue the selection process. Whatever your ambition, at Eni you can find the tools to make it happen. Energy for action takers #LI-EIRL

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Spain
jobs_results.description:
Project Manager

Details
• Madrid
• Operations
• Full-time

About Otovo

Are you looking for an opportunity to positively impact the world while working for a rapidly growing and innovative company? Look no further!

Our mission is to make solar panels and batteries accessible to every European home by creating the easiest and most affordable way to go solar. We do this by connecting consumers who want solar panels or batteries with installer companies through our marketplace. As a result, we are revolutionizing how people think about renewable energy and helping create a more sustainable future.

Since our establishment in 2016, Otovo has rapidly scaled its marketplace beyond the Nordics and operates in thirteen European countries.

Join our team in Madrid and become part of a company that is revolutionizing the renewable energy industry. As a listed company on Oslo Stock Exchange, there's never been a better time to join our journey. Apply now to join the Otovo team and help us... create a brighter future for all!

About your role:
Project Manager

Start: ASAP

Location: Ríos Rosas 36, Madrid

Job Summary:

As a Project Manager at Otovo, you will manage the delivery of solar energy projects from start to finish. You will work closely with the rest of the internal teams to ensure project success within budget, scope, and timeline constraints. You will also be responsible for managing project risks and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Key Responsibilities:
• Project planning and execution activities: Enjoy the fast-paced project manager position managing solar panel installations in customers' homes.
• Collaborate with project teams to define project scope and goals
• Manage project timelines and ensure deliverables are completed on time
• Responsible for meeting weekly and monthly targets for throughout, quality, and customer satisfaction targets.
• Ensure customer satisfaction through your deliveries
• Coordinate and lead project status meetings with stakeholders
• Manage project risks and develop contingency plans
• Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies
• Communicate project progress and status updates to management
• Perform quality control checks of solar installations and subcontractor deliveries.
• Emphasize quality, systematic work, and well-documented work processes.
• Develop and implement training programs for new employees to ensure consistent, high-quality work.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager (Medical Insights Reporting)
jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM Consulting is looking for a Project Manager (Medical Insights Reporting) that would like to collaborate with one of the top 15 global pharmaceutical companies.

Main taks

• Insights metrics for the defined stakeholder groups

• Insights review and analytics, detecting trends and relevant specificities and upcoming key topics of interest

• Insights assessment per defined business questions

• Utilize innovative solutions within Medical Insights Management for assessment and analytics

• Develop meaningful business reports with executive summary and insights summarization per relevant defined categories and tags, when required present the results in specific forums

• Service adhoc requests for specific analytical needs, for example for congress or competitive intelligence activities

Required experience

• Bachelor's degree in Health Sciences, Health Technology Sciences or equivalent work experience

• Strong project management skills, experience in project teams and... developing scientific summaries and presentations

• At least 3 years experience in a scientific environment preferably healthcare related

• Or 1-2 years experience in Medical Operations or MSL role or content-specific Medical Technical Support

• English fluent in written, reading, speaking. Spanish/ German or other language would be a plus, but not a must - work will be 100% in English

WHAT DO WE OFFER
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Trainings & Certifications. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention.

About us

We are a digital global company whose mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, #LifeandSciences, #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 500 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow
